question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Get the ball rolling
solution:
The correct answer is: **Set an activity in motion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**Get the ball rolling**" means to initiate or start an activity. (किसी गतिविधि को शुरू करना)
 
• It is often used in a group setting to encourage someone to take the first step in starting a project or discussion.
 
 
• **Example**: *Let's get the ball rolling on this project.*
 
 
 
• It can also be used in a personal context to motivate oneself to begin a task.
